title: Trothyr's Rest
subtitle: Quest: Trothyr's War Hammer or Shield, in the locked rooms
steps: In the Facility Hub, talk to the Warden about Trothyr.
Get a key from the merchant at 13.6N 50.7E (portal behind the Warden), or bring a lockpick.
Return and go to 10.3N 54.9E for the portal into Trothyr's Rest.
Take Trothyr's War Hammer (or his Shield).
Show it to the Warden for the reward.

notes.title: Locked doors
notes.body: The door at the upper hall needs the Trothyr's Rest key. Four other doors need a master key or lockpicking.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Liches take 0.2 cold, 0.52 pierce, 0.75 bludgeon and acid, 0.86 lightning. Slash and fire do full damage.

notes.title: Items
notes.body: Both the Hammer and the Shield are placed in the data. Either counts for the Warden's reward text.
